mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, email, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, phone, status, create_time FROM `user` WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, username, email, phone, status, create_time FROM `user` ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
